triggers.prompt: Clean up the branches that have already merged.
triggers.expected: Fires, and verifies each deletion against the forge rather than against git.

triggers.prompt: 清理一下仓库，收拾下没用的分支
Remove the worktrees I am no longer using.
triggers.expected: Fires, and keeps any worktree whose branch has no merged pull request.

triggers.prompt: 清掉已经合并过的分支
triggers.expected: Fires on a second Chinese phrasing rather than only on 清理一下.

triggers.prompt: There are a dozen merged branches still sitting on GitHub. Prune them.
triggers.expected: Fires, and deletes the branches on the remote rather than only pruning local tracking refs.

triggers.prompt: 远程还留着一堆合并过的分支，清一下
triggers.expected: Fires on the Chinese phrasing for the remote side.

non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Uncommitted work is not residue.

non_triggers.prompt: Reset this branch to origin and throw away my commits.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. It never discards a local commit.

non_triggers.prompt: Delete all untracked files in here.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire on untracked files the user has not been shown.

non_triggers.prompt: 把我没提交的改动都扔掉
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Discarding uncommitted work is destructive and outside this skill, in either language.

behaviors.prompt: Delete every remote branch that has already merged. One of them, dependabot/github_actions/actions-435dda8292, carries no merged pull request but does have open pull request #22.
expectations: Keeps dependabot/github_actions/actions-435dda8292 and names open pull request #22 as the reason.
States that deleting the branch would close that pull request.
Deletes the merged branches without holding them back over the one exception.

behaviors.prompt: Clean up. One local branch has no pull request at all and its upstream is gone, but git merge-base --is-ancestor says every one of its commits is already on main.
expectations: Deletes it, because nothing is lost when the base already contains every commit.
Reports which test cleared it rather than only reporting that no pull request was found.
Does not treat the missing pull request alone as a reason to keep it.

behaviors.prompt: Clean up the worktrees. You are running inside .claude/worktrees/foo, whose branch merged as #42 and whose tree is clean.
expectations: Keeps .claude/worktrees/foo and gives running inside it as the reason.
Does not change directory out of it and remove it anyway.
Still removes any other worktree that is clean and merged.
